en.title: Governments Urged to Meet Accessibility Deadlines Amid New Funding and Upgrades
en.summary: State and local governments are being urged to meet upcoming accessibility compliance deadlines, as outlined in a GovTech guide detailing legal requirements and practical steps. Simultaneously, the Australian government opened consultation on a $200 million Inclusive Communities Fund, while U.S. authorities announced a new grant program to improve bus safety and accessibility. Infrastructure upgrades are also underway at Floral Park and Bellerose LIRR stations, and developers explore AI agents to enhance mobile game accessibility for players with disabilities.

highlights.title: How State, Local Governments Can Make the Accessibility Deadline - GovTech
Consultation opens for Inclusive Communities Fund
Floral Park, Bellerose LIRR stations to receive accessibility upgrades
NOFO: Bus Safety, Accessibility and Innovation Grant Program (US)
AI Agents for Mobile Game Accessibility

zh-TW.title: 各國政府推動無障礙期限，結合新資金與車站升級
zh-TW.summary: 各國政府正被促請落實即將到來的無障礙合規期限，GovTech 提供法律要求與實務步驟的指引。澳洲政府啟動2億美元包容性社區基金諮詢，美國則推出巴士安全與無障礙補助金計畫。花園公園與貝勒羅斯 LIRR 車站將進行無障礙升級，同時一位日本使用者分享申請精神障礙證明的經驗。

highlights.title: 州和地方政府如何達到無障礙期限 - GovTech
